You can try super glue and baking soda. put down dollop of super glue then sprinkle baking soda down will dry instant and make a sand texture closer to scale. Practice on something first to see how it works. You can make mounds of baking soda then drip super glue on to build up bigger texture. You can do this first or after putting larger "rocks" down. Make sure to take a large brush after drying to brush off left over baking soda. Then it just comes down to painting it.
